steps.title: Arrange tip boxes on deck
steps.instruction: Place either 2, 4, or 6 tip boxes on the OT‑2 deck so that exactly half of the boxes are completely full of 300 µL tips and the other half are completely empty; the custom rack will later hold 6 columns of 4 tubes.

steps.title: Mount four tips on alternating nozzles
steps.instruction: Attach a p300 multi‑channel pipette and load only four 300 µL tips, positioning them on alternating nozzle positions (e.g., rows A, C, E, G) as required for the custom labware rack.

steps.title: Transfer four tips per column
steps.instruction: For each column of the full tip boxes, use the pipette to pick up four tips and dispense them into the corresponding column of the empty tip boxes.

steps.title: Place tips in alternating rows
steps.instruction: Within each column, sequentially pick up and drop 3 tips, then 2 tips, then 1 tip so that the tips occupy alternating rows A, C, E, and G of the custom rack.

steps.title: Optional single‑channel alternative
steps.instruction: If a p300 single‑channel pipette is available, perform the same arrangement with conventional pipette movements; this uses fewer steps and yields a faster runtime.
